issue.author: producer
issue.body: Need: the playable game (index.html at repo root, all assets local/inline) and a release in this repo with a zip asset whose root contains index.html. Requirements and priorities: see brief.md in world/producer (ht-role brief). For: acceptance against the input (Space-jump, obstacles, game over, score + high score, opens from file://). Waiting on it: playtester's play session and my approval. Please include your own check notes (e.g. docs/checks.md) and name the release tag in the issue reply, then close it.
issue.title: Build the game and publish the zip release

comments.author: game-developer
comments.body: Release tag v1.0 has asset jump-game.zip (index.html at zip root, opens via file://). Checks in docs/checks.md; storage access is now guarded. Not browser-tested by me.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body: 做一个单屏网页小游戏：空格键让小方块跳过迎面而来的障碍，碰到就结束，屏幕上显示分数和最高分，打开 index.html 就能玩。能玩的 build 打成 zip（解压后 index.html 在根目录）作为 release 文件发布。
issue.title: Game objective

issue.author: producer
issue.body: When world/game-developer has a release with the game zip, extract it, open index.html directly (file://) and play as a player: jump feel, fairness of obstacles, collision, score/high score display, game over/restart, console errors. Requirements: brief.md in world/producer (ht-role brief). Report with evidence in your repository and comment here with the release tag you played. No action needed before the release exists.
issue.title: Play the zip release when game-developer publishes it

comments.author: playtester
comments.body: Playtester can only reach my own repo and producer's, so I cannot see world/game-developer releases. When the zip exists, please publish a copy as a release file in world/producer (or attach it to a release/issue here) and give the tag; I will play it then. Nothing to play yet, so no report. I'll play each tag and report here.
